text:
Emily Chen: Heads up — I'm coordinating runtime + infra for a new continuous batching dashboard. Before we lock the wireframes we need cross-team input on metric shapes, cardinality, sampling, retention, and what the Console needs for rollouts/alerts. Quick bullets of requirements in-thread please.

Raj Patel: For routing policies we really need per-route batch_size percentiles (p50/p90/p99) and a small sample of actual payload shapes to detect route skew. Global-only hides important signals.

Carlos Mendez: Agree on per-route. From infra: we should also emit occupied_slots (how many slots in a batch) and dispatch_latency to compute fill-rate and effective throughput. We can emit histograms every 30s. Cardinality note: per-model+region+route can explode.

Tina Lopez: Console/product wants a heatmap that lets users pivot by route -> model -> pool and then drill into pods. Also want alerting signals for sustained high wait_time (e.g., >200ms p95 for 5m).

Emily Chen: Proposed metric proto (open to bikeshedding):
```
# counters/gauges/histograms we plan to emit
batch_size_count{route="/chat",model="rwd-7b",region="us-west2",pool="dedicated"} 1
batch_size_bucket{route="/chat",model="rwd-7b",region="us-west2",le="1"} 42
batch_wait_ms_bucket{route="/chat",model="rwd-7b",region="us-west2",le="50"} 100
queue_saturation{pool="shared",region="us-east1"} 0.73
dispatch_latency_ms{pool="dedicated",pod_id="pod-123",route="/embed"} 12
```
Keep labels minimal: route, model, region, pool; include pod_id only on sampled events.

Laura Kim: Runtime can emit HDR histograms for batch_wait and batch_size; we can pre-aggregate p50/p90/p99 to reduce cardinality. Also runtime can include a per-route `sample_rate` label if teams want different sampling on busy routes.

Mike H.: From SRE/observability: retention proposals — keep rollups (p50/p90/p99) 90d, high-res histograms 14d, raw sampled events 7d. Also need cost estimate for initial sampling (e.g., 5%).

Carlos Mendez: Rough cost: with 5% sampling on current qps, expect ~600GB/day of telemetry ingested. If we pre-aggregate at source (emit quantiles only) that drops to ~80GB/day. We'll need an infra cost sign-off.

Raj Patel: Suggestion: base metrics emitted for every request: minimal counter/gauge without pod_id. Then sampled trace with pod_id + payload shape for 1% by default, adjustable per-route. That supports drilldowns without exploding cardinality.

Tina Lopez: UX note: for rollouts UI we want a "safemode" toggle to hide pod-level IDs for privacy/compliance customers. Also show model-version in the heatmap.

Emily Chen: Action items I see: 1) runtime -> emit HDR histograms + source-quantiles (owner: Laura) 2) infra -> cost estimate for 1%, 5% sampling and pre-agg (owner: Carlos) 3) product/console -> wireframe heatmap + alerting rules (owner: Tina) 4) SRE -> retention/cost policy (owner: Mike). Can owners confirm ETA?

Laura Kim: ETA for a first proto of emitted metrics from runtime is EOW (Fri). Will include source-side quantiles and the histogram buckets.

Carlos Mendez: I'll have a draft cost estimate by Tue next week. Also will prototype a small ingestion pipeline to pre-aggregate by route+model.

Mike H.: I'll draft retention/alerting policy by Wed. Suggest we put an A/B on sample rate: default 1% with opt-in per-route to 5/10%.

Tina Lopez: I'll update the wireframe and mock the heatmap with the proposed labels. Expect a first pass in 4 business days.

Emily Chen: Great — can folks drop follow-up questions here. One outstanding question from runtime: is it okay to pre-compute p99 at source? That would avoid shipping raw histograms for the busiest routes.

Raj Patel: precompute p99 is fine as long as we also ship the count and the bucket breakdown for auditing. Need to be careful about making p99 opaque.

infra-bot: New ticket created: INF-4721 "Batching telemetry proto + cost estimate" assigned to Carlos Mendez.

Emily Chen: Thanks everyone. We'll sync briefly in Thurs's eng-platform async stand to finalize labels. :thumbsup:
